acceptanceCriteria: Linux run (host tuple recorded) of the scale measurements: process checks, idle CPU per minute, ReadDir with d_type, with results retained.
Any Linux-only divergence is filed or fixed.
body:
Gap: the scale work (V1-0893, V1-0645) was measured on darwin only. Unqualified on Linux: /proc-based process liveness checks, idle CPU, and ReadDir behaviour relying on d_type.

Source: batch 4 lanes for GitHub #641-#647, 2026-10-06 (branches claude/v1-0645-audit-outside-lock, claude/scale-tasks-v1-0893, claude/scale-core-v1-0416, claude/gh644-live-upgrade). Darwin 25.6.0, go1.27.1. Versions: corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202; corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360).
title: Linux qualification of the Tasks scale work: /proc process checks, idle CPU and d_type ReadDir
